title: 5 Seconds of Summer Bring Out The Wiggles in Melbourne
summary:
5 Seconds of Summer gave their Melbourne crowd a surprise on Monday night, November 2, bringing out The Wiggles during the last song of their Rod Laver Arena show.

The Australian pop-rock group were finishing the night with "Everyone's a Star!" when the children's music icons joined them onstage, turning the finale into a distinctly Australian crossover moment.

The surprise featured members of The Wiggles' current lineup alongside familiar characters including Dorothy the Dinosaur, Wags the Dog, Henry the Octopus and the Tree of Wisdom. Original Purple Wiggle Jeff Fatt also joined the performance.

"We love what they do, and it's always so special to celebrate incredible Aussie talent," Yellow Wiggle Tsehay Hawkins said. "We couldn't wait to jump on stage to bring a little Wiggly magic to their final song of the night. It was so much fun."

The Melbourne show is part of 5 Seconds of Summer's Everyone's a Star! World Tour. The tour has already taken the band through Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne.
why_it_matters: Surprise team-ups can make a concert you attend with family into a memory you talk about for years.
